notes.title: Achievements & Mails Update
notes.content:
[b]Updated:[/b]
- mails are now properly translated
- all Chinese and Japanese characters now should display correctly
- achievement "Open World" can now be obtained (bug fixed)
- removed achievement "Story Digger"
- some other localization issues fixed (ex - PC notifications)
- added more lights to Cave to make it easier to navigate (+ all the lights are a little brighter)
- added light optimization for Cave

[b]Note: If you will find any more issues/bugs - please, report them in Steam Community or tell about them on Discord[/b]

notes.title: Cave Update
notes.content:
Changed:
- cave has a little new content now to tell just a little more story and make the exploration more interesting
- cave is now easier
- increased brightness in cave (+ fixed bug with brightness working the other way in cave)
- fixed more of translations

Known issues that will be fixed in the next update:
- not all emails are localized
- some Chinese characters are not displayed

[b]Update: Right now the next update is ready, but the game started to crash, so the update will be published as soon as I will figure out how to fix crashes. Thanks for understanding![/b]
